rationale: Select the registered full multimodal pointcloud reward and set its supported time_ramp_power to 0 as a temporal-neutral comparison. The supplied endpoint time deltas vary in direction, and the Analyst found no reliable temporal trend; this choice avoids imposing an unsupported time-dependent emphasis while retaining the full family's stage-specific elite-coordinate and affinity-weight history. The observed pair-kernel and localized occupancy associations are correlational and do not establish causal coordinate updates.
failure_modes: A zero ramp may discard useful stage-specific temporal structure, even though the supplied evidence does not establish its direction.
The endpoint associations are exploratory and observational; they may not reproduce under intervention or generalize beyond I0_full.
The full family depends on stage-specific elite coordinates and affinity weights, so its outcome cannot be attributed to this single parameter change alone.
Gradient-normalized optimization may reduce the effect of whole-scalar rescaling, and coordinate reward components do not guarantee improved final pIC50 or low strain.
